newsitem.title: UK: Liverpool cotton subdued, eyes US futures.
newsitem.headline: Liverpool cotton subdued, eyes US futures.

text.p: Activity on most European raw cotton markets was restricted, pending crop developments in the Southern hemisphere and further direction from New York futures.

A steadier tone on futures on Friday imparted some stability to the asking rates for most upland styles. Central Asian and West African were the subject of most inquiry, mainly for shipment during the second and third quarters of the year.
But genuine buying interest was limited. Mill demand for shipments further forward was very restricted and traders showed no inclination to offer new crop cotton more agressively than hitherto.
